SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') AND c.relname = ANY($2) ORDER BY 1

CREATE TABLE "public"."dept" ( "id" bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL, "name" varchar(30) NOT NULL, "code" varchar(3) DEFAULT 'ABC', "budget" numeric(12,2) DEFAULT 0, "active" boolean DEFAULT true, "opened" date, "at" timestamp, "atz" timestamptz, "t" time, "tiny" smallint, "mid" integer, "f4" real, "f8" double precision, "data" bytea, "doc" jsonb, "uid" uuid, "tags" text, "note" text DEFAULT 'x', "made" text DEFAULT to_char(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), "stamp" timestamptz DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT "dept_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CONSTRAINT "dept_name_key" UNIQUE ("name") )

CREATE TABLE "public"."emp" ( "id" bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL, "dept_id" integer, "boss" bigint, "name" text NOT NULL, "double_id" integer, CONSTRAINT "emp_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id") )
CREATE TABLE "public"."link" ( "a" integer NOT NULL, "b" integer NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "link_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("a", "b") )
CREATE TABLE "public"."noident" ( "id" integer NOT NULL, "k" text NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "noident_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id", "k") )
ALTER TABLE "public"."dept" ADD CONSTRAINT "dept_note_chk" CHECK ((note IN ('x', 'y')))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "emp_boss" ON "public"."emp" ("boss") WHERE (boss IS NOT NULL)
ALTER TABLE "public"."emp" ADD CONSTRAINT "emp_dept_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("dept_id") REFERENCES "public"."dept" ("id") ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
ALTER TABLE "public"."emp" ADD CONSTRAINT "emp_boss_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("boss") REFERENCES "public"."emp" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL
ALTER TABLE "public"."link" ADD CONSTRAINT "link_a_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("a") REFERENCES "public"."dept" ("id")

WITH s AS ( SELECT d.refobjid::regclass::text AS name FROM pg_attrdef ad JOIN pg_depend d ON d.classid = 'pg_attrdef'::regclass AND d.objid = ad.oid AND d.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass JOIN pg_class sc ON sc.oid = d.refobjid AND sc.relkind = 'S' WHERE ad.adrelid = $1::text::regclass AND ad.adnum = (SELECT attnum FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid = $1::text::regclass AND attname = $2)) SELECT COALESCE(pg_get_serial_sequence($1, $2), (SELECT min(name) FROM s WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM s) = 1))

WITH s AS ( SELECT d.refobjid::regclass::text AS name FROM pg_attrdef ad JOIN pg_depend d ON d.classid = 'pg_attrdef'::regclass AND d.objid = ad.oid AND d.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass JOIN pg_class sc ON sc.oid = d.refobjid AND sc.relkind = 'S' WHERE ad.adrelid = $1::text::regclass AND ad.adnum = (SELECT attnum FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid = $1::text::regclass AND attname = $2)) SELECT COALESCE(pg_get_serial_sequence($1, $2), (SELECT min(name) FROM s WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM s) = 1))

SELECT c.oid::bigint, c.relname, c.relkind::text, c.relispartition, c.relrowsecurity FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') ORDER BY c.relname

SELECT a.attnum, a.attname, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod), tt.typname, tt.typtype::text, tt.typcategory::text, a.attnotnull, COALESCE(pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid), ''), a.attidentity::text, a.attgenerated::text, COALESCE(col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum), ''), (a.attcollation <> 0 AND a.attcollation <> tt.typcollation) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_type tt ON tt.oid = a.atttypid LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum WHERE a.attrelid = $1 AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY a.attnum

SELECT sn.nspname, s.relname FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_class s ON s.oid = d.objid AND s.relkind = 'S' JOIN pg_namespace sn ON sn.oid = s.relnamespace WHERE d.refobjid = $1 AND d.refobjsubid = $2 AND d.deptype IN ('a','i') LIMIT 1
SELECT seqstart, seqincrement FROM pg_sequence s JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = s.seqrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND c.relname = $2

SELECT c.conname, c.contype::text, (SELECT string_agg(a.attname, E'\037' ORDER BY k.ord) FROM unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(n, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND a.attnum = k.n), COALESCE(rn.nspname, ''), COALESCE(rc.relname, ''), (SELECT string_agg(a.attname, E'\037' ORDER BY k.ord) FROM unnest(c.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(n, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.confrelid AND a.attnum = k.n), c.confupdtype::text, c.confdeltype::text, c.condeferrable, c.condeferred, c.convalidated, pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid), c.confmatchtype::text FROM pg_constraint c LEFT JOIN pg_class rc ON rc.oid = c.confrelid LEFT JOIN pg_namespace rn ON rn.oid = rc.relnamespace WHERE c.conrelid = $1 ORDER BY c.conname

SELECT ic.relname, i.indisunique, am.amname, i.indpred IS NOT NULL, COALESCE(pg_get_expr(i.indpred, i.indrelid), ''), i.indnkeyatts, i.indnatts, (SELECT string_agg(CASE WHEN k.n = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.attname END, E'\037' ORDER BY k.ord) FROM unnest(i.indkey::int2[]) WITH ORDINALITY k(n, ord) LEFT JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = i.indrelid AND a.attnum = k.n), array_to_string(i.indoption::int2[], ','), i.indexprs IS NOT NULL, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.conindid = i.indexrelid AND c.contype IN ('p','u','x')) FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = ic.relam WHERE i.indrelid = $1 ORDER BY ic.relname
